args.sql:
WITH therapy_details AS (
  SELECT 
    txkey, 
    (
      therapy_details ->> 'engagement' 
    )::float AS engagement_score, 
    therapy_details ->> 'changes' AS change_type 
  FROM 
    treatmentbasics 
) 
SELECT 
  change_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences, 
  AVG(
    engagement_score
  ) - AVG(engagement_score) OVER() AS avg_engagement_variation 
FROM 
  therapy_details 
GROUP BY 
  change_type 
ORDER BY 
  avg_engagement_variation DESC;
